summary:
AGROX is a Tamil Nadu-focused smart farming prototype that uses NASA Earth observation data to support farmers in making informed crop-planning decisions.

Our website combines NASA POWER weather and solar radiation data with user-provided soil pH, crop selection, and planting date. It analyses temperature, rainfall, humidity, soil pH, and planting seasons to calculate a crop suitability score out of 100.

The prototype supports five crops: Rice, Ragi, Groundnut, Maize, and Cotton. It also displays recent weather conditions and a simplified 90-day crop growth outlook.

Our goal is to make space-based environmental data easier to understand and useful for agricultural planning. AGROX currently supports selected locations in Tamil Nadu. Its results are estimates, not guaranteed crop-yield predictions.
details: AGROX is a smart agriculture web application designed to support farmers in Tamil Nadu using NASA Earth observation data. The platform analyses environmental conditions such as temperature, rainfall, humidity, solar radiation, and soil pH to help users understand crop suitability. Users can select their location, enter soil information, choose a crop, and provide a planting date. The system processes the available environmental data and generates a crop suitability score along with a simplified 90-day outlook. The project focuses on making satellite-based environmental information accessible and understandable for farmers, students, and agricultural beginners. We developed this prototype using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python with FastAPI for backend functionality. Our main objective is to demonstrate how NASA Earth observation data can support informed agricultural planning in Tamil Nadu.
